summary: Frontend regression validated: Home SectionBlock now receives forceKind from SOURCE_ENDPOINTS so TV-series sections render SeriesCard regardless of backend-provided type (e.g. 'Scripted'). All critical flows pass.

issues: React hydration warning: <button> nested inside another <button> in the season accordion header (SeriesEdit.jsx around line 662-668 — a Button is rendered inside the collapse-trigger button). Not a regression from this task, but logs a console error.

hero-featured-cta links to /movies/{id} (plural) for non-series items while MovieCard links to /movie/{id} (singular). Inconsistent path — may 404 if the /movies/:id route is not aliased. Pre-existing, not covered by this fix but worth confirming.

action_items: (Optional) Fix nested <button> in SeriesEdit season accordion to clear hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx fix is correct and minimal: forceKind is passed only for built-in sections (where kind is known from endpoint), while custom sections still rely on item.type (which is 'movie'|'series' as resolved by backend). This cleanly resolves the 'Scripted' collision.
Fallback heuristic `it.type === 'series' || it.type === 'movie' ? it.type : 'movie'` in SectionBlock is a sensible safety net for custom items whose backend type is anything else.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: /api/series/trending and /api/series/recent items have type='Scripted' (series Type model) but Home now forces SeriesCard via forceKind='series'. Trending TV Series anchors point to /series/{id}; Trending Movies anchors point to /movie/{id}. Direct series page and SeriesEdit load without 'Failed to load' toasts.
rca of the issue: RCA (already fixed by main agent): /series/trending etc. include a `type` field equal to Series.type model field (e.g. 'Scripted', 'Mini-Series'). Home SectionBlock heuristic `it.type === 'series'` evaluated false and fell back to MovieCard which links to /movie/{seriesId}. Opening that id as a movie 404'd and MovieDetail toasted 'Failed to load movie'. Fix: SectionBlock accepts forceKind, Home passes SOURCE_ENDPOINTS[s.source].kind for built-in sections so TV sections always render SeriesCard.
